fact: The Personal Data Protection Act, Chapter 44, published in the Gazette on 13 June 2023 (the document's published date; no commencement date is given in the captured text), contains Part V on transborder data flow: section 31 on transfer of personal data to a state with adequate data protection and section 32 on transfer to a state without adequate protection.

A doctrinal study in the East African Journal of Law and Ethics (Josephina John), published 24 August 2026 (no other date given), finds Tanzania's legal framework on cross-border data transfers progressive on paper but incomplete in practice, with institutional capacity and enforcement gaps, and cites the Personal Data Protection Act Cap. 44 R.E. 2023 and the Data Protection (Collection and Processing Personal Data) Regulations, GN No. 349 of 2023.

The PDPC found in preliminary assessments limited understanding of obligations, inaccurate registration data and unlawful data transfers abroad, and listed rectification directives, warning letters and fines as remedies; no sanction is named.
